run_timed_subprocess: run a subprocess command and log its execution duration with a TimedCompletedProcess result
run_command_with_retry: run a shell command with automatic retries and exponential backoff with jitter
run_git_with_retry: run a git command with retries and treat nothing to commit as success
use_log_time_context: use a context manager to log elapsed time for a block of code
use_timed_decorator: decorate a function to automatically log its execution time on each call
